fields.name: id
fields.note: read_battle: sub_1733B0 / sub_173460 assert it < 256 and index UNIT.TBL section 2 (32-byte rows) with it; sub_173220 indexes the 17-byte MSG.TBL names the same way

fields.name: status rate
fields.note: read_battle: datScriptGetValue selector 18; the AICALC slot-16 formulas (sub_30D610 / sub_30E8A0 / sub_30FAF0) multiply it by the target's affinity rate to the status element and a luck ratio

fields.name: flags (0x20 active)
fields.note: read_battle: sub_27E310 / sub_27E390 skip a packet whose +71 & 0x20 is clear

fields.name: turn override a
fields.note: read_battle: sub_29A3E0 returns 1 when it is non-zero

fields.name: turn override b
fields.note: read_battle: sub_29A3E0 returns 1 when it is non-zero

fields.name: item id
fields.note: read_battle: sub_16F630 returns it for owner -1 / 1 / pc

fields.name: effect
fields.note: read_battle: sub_16F900 returns it; sub_300750 and datCalcCountEquipmentWithEffect compare it with an effect id
